product.name: DIDGE Autonomous Robots
product.description: Autonomous robots designed for capturing high-quality 360-degree images on construction sites, enabling precise AI-driven insights.

product.name: Didge Progress Tracking
product.description: AI-powered service for tracking construction progress, validating work completion, and reviewing subcontractor invoices based on visual data.

product.name: Construction Safety Management
product.description: Utilizes AI and autonomous robots for detecting safety violations, providing detailed safety reports, and monitoring site safety in real-time.

product.name: Immersive 3D Environment
product.description: Offers a virtual walkthrough of construction sites, allowing for detailed inspection and collaboration remotely.

product.name: BIM Compare Tool
product.description: Compares real-time site conditions against BIM models to identify discrepancies and ensure accuracy in construction.
